home.seoTitle: Inventory Management System | Household Supplies, Categories, and Low Stock Notifications
home.title: Keep household and daily supplies easy to track
home.description: Manage item quantities, categories, storage locations, and low stock alerts in one place, then receive email notifications when supplies need attention.

googleSheets.title: Organize items quickly
googleSheets.description: Use categories, locations, and groups to make everyday lookup, restocking, and inventory checks easier.

database.title: Low stock notifications
database.description: Set a safety threshold for each item and send reminders when quantities fall below the level you choose.

stack.title: Clear activity history
stack.description: Item creation, updates, and deletions are recorded so inventory changes stay easy to review.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Track inventory totals, low stock items, and activity from the last 7 days.

lowStock.title: Low stock alerts
lowStock.description: Items whose quantity is at or below their custom threshold.

categoryChart.title: Items by main category
categoryChart.description: See how current items are distributed across main categories.

recentMovements.title: Recent logs

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Review your account information and choose whether to receive daily low stock notifications.

lowStockNotification.title: Low stock notification
lowStockNotification.description: Automatically send low stock items to your email every day at midnight.

quickUse.title: Quick use
quickUse.description: Enter a barcode or upload a barcode image. Existing items open the edit page, and unknown barcodes open the create item page.
quickUse.routeHint: After the barcode is recognized, the system will route you to the right workflow automatically.
quickUse.unsupported: Barcode image detection is not supported by this browser. You can still enter the barcode manually.
quickUse.unsupportedImageType: This image format is not supported. Please use JPG, PNG, or WebP.
quickUse.noBarcodeFound: No barcode was detected in this image.
quickUse.existingItemDescription: This barcode matches an inventory item. Adjust the quantity below.
quickUse.newItemDescription: No item uses this barcode yet. Create a new inventory item with this barcode.

data.title: Data
data.description: Manage item categories, storage locations, groups, and inventory records.

sections.listDescription: Review, edit, delete, and export current inventory items.
sections.currentDataDescription: Review the categories, locations, and groups you have created.

pages.editItemDescription: Update item details while keeping a clear activity history.
pages.itemListDescription: Browse every inventory item and quickly check quantity, category, location, and barcode details.
